lines.say: Five Israeli street names. Each one hides a secret meaning.
In the fifteen hundreds, the family lived in a Frankfurt house with a red shield sign.
The boulevard honours Baron Edmond de Rothschild.
Ben Gurion was born David Groon. Groon means green.
In nineteen ten, he took a new name, from a Jewish rebel against Rome.
Sokolov. Sokol is Russian for falcon.
Nahum Sokolov later led the World Zionist Organization.
Kaplan comes from Latin. A cape, then a chaplain, a priest.
Many Kaplan families are <<k|oʊ|h|ɑ|ˈ|n|i|m>>, Jewish priests. The street honours Israel's first finance minister.
Most likely, the family came from a town called Ostrov. And in Raanana, the first mayor was Baruch Ostrovsky.
So what does your surname mean? Tell me in the comments.

sources.label: The Rothschild Archive, name and arms

caption_en:
The street you live on might be named after a falcon.

Rothschild: "red shield", from a 1500s house sign in Frankfurt's Jewish street (The Rothschild Archive).
Ben Gurion: born David Grün, "green"; took the name Ben Gurion in 1910, after a Jewish leader of the revolt against Rome (Jewish Virtual Library).
Sokolov: from "sokol", Russian for falcon (Wikipedia, Sokolov surname). Nahum Sokolow led the World Zionist Organization from 1931 (Britannica).
Kaplan: from Latin, via "chaplain"; a name often carried by Kohanim families (Chabad.org). Kaplan Street honours Eliezer Kaplan, Israel's first finance minister.
Ostrovsky: from "ostrov", island; most likely from a town called Ostrov or Ostrów (Wikipedia, Ostrovsky surname). Baruch Ostrovsky was Ra'anana's first mayor.

What does your surname mean? Tell me in the comments.

caption_he:
שם הרחוב שלך מסתיר משמעות.

רוטשילד: "מגן אדום" (Rot + Schild), על שם שלט של בית בפרנקפורט במאה ה-16.
בן גוריון: נולד דוד גרין, Grün = ירוק. את השם בן גוריון לקח ב-1910.
סוקולוב: sokol ברוסית = בז.
קפלן: מלטינית, דרך chaplain = כומר. הרבה משפחות קפלן הן כהנים.
אוסטרובסקי: ostrov = אי. כנראה ממשפחה שהגיעה מעיירה בשם אוסטרוב.

ומה המשמעות של שם המשפחה שלך? כתבו לי בתגובות, ושלחו למישהו עם שם משפחה מעניין.
